targetText: Whoever brings about even the slightest weakening of the iron discipline of the party of the proletariat (especially during its dictatorship), is actually aiding the bourgeoisie against the proletariat.
explanation: Bolshevik party discipline was not maintained through blind obedience, but through vanguard class-consciousness, deep ties to working people, and practical tactical success.

targetText: This should unite all workers who follow the slogan: ‘Get out of the trade unions!’ It is here that the militant proletariat musters its ranks for battle.
summary: Lenin refutes the ultra-left slogan 'Get out of the trade unions!' as sectarian isolation from the working masses.
explanation: Lenin refutes ultra-leftists who wanted to abandon conservative trade unions. Revolutionaries must work inside flawed mass institutions where real workers are located.

targetText: Accordingly, all compromise with other parties, all reversion to parliamentary forms of struggle which have become historically and politically obsolete, and any policy of manoeuvring and compromise must be emphatically rejected.
summary: Ultra-left dogmatism rejects all tactical maneuvering and parliamentary struggle on abstract principle.
explanation: Distinguishing between necessary tactical compromises that preserve organizational strength vs. opportunist surrenders of principle is essential for political leadership.
